segments.name: Inpatient rehabilitation
segments.description: Operates a national network of inpatient rehabilitation hospitals providing specialized rehabilitative treatment to patients recovering from strokes, injuries, and other debilitating conditions.
segments.evidence: We manage our operations using one operating segment which is also our reportable segment: inpatient rehabilitation.

revenueModel.text: The company is paid by Medicare, Medicare Advantage and other payors for inpatient rehabilitative care provided to patients, with substantially all patients admitted from acute-care hospitals.
revenueModel.evidence: Substantially all (92%) of the patients we serve are admitted from acute-care hospitals following physician referrals for specific acute inpatient rehabilitative care.
